adopt.alien: DayZ is running on this machine ({s}, PID {pid}), but it is not ours{port}. The port may be taken.
cfg.bad_enc: Encoding is {enc} — will be saved as UTF-8 without BOM

cfgvar.MaxPing: Ping (ms) at which a player is kicked from the server.
cfgvar.adminLogPlayerHitsOnly: 1 — log player hits only, 0 — all hits (animals/infected).
cfgvar.adminLogPlayerList: Periodic player list with positions (every 5 minutes).
cfgvar.allowFilePatching: Allow clients with -filePatching (required for debugging unpacked sources).
cfgvar.clientPort: Forces the port clients connect with.
cfgvar.defaultObjectViewDistance: Highest object render distance on the server.
cfgvar.defaultVisibility: Highest terrain render distance on the server.
cfgvar.description: Server description in the server browser (up to 255 characters).
cfgvar.disablePersonalLight: Disable personal light for all connected clients.
cfgvar.disableRespawnDialog: Hide the respawn point selection dialog.
cfgvar.enableDebugMonitor: Show the debug monitor to players.
cfgvar.forceSameBuild: Only allow clients with the same game build.
cfgvar.guaranteedUpdates: Communication protocol with the game server (use only 1).
cfgvar.hostname: Server name shown in the server browser.
cfgvar.instanceId: Instance identifier (storage_<id> folder inside the mission).
cfgvar.logAverageFps: Log average server FPS every N seconds (needs -doLogs).
cfgvar.logFile: Server console log file in the profile folder.
cfgvar.logMemory: Log memory usage every N seconds (needs -doLogs).
cfgvar.logPlayers: Log connected player count every N seconds (needs -doLogs).
cfgvar.loginQueueConcurrentPlayers: How many players are processed concurrently during login.
cfgvar.loginQueueMaxPlayers: Maximum number of players waiting in the login queue.
cfgvar.multithreadedReplication: Multithreaded replication (thread count comes from dayzsettings.xml).
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchBandwidthLimit: The limit itself: fraction [0,1] or number [1,∞) — depends on the setting above.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchCompute: Objects checked for create/delete per server frame.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchEnforceBandwidt: Limit object creation based on bandwidth usage.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchLogSlow: Threshold (sec): logs a network "bubble" if processing takes longer.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchSendCreate: Maximum objects sent for creation per frame.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchSendDelete: Maximum objects sent for deletion per frame.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchUseDynamicMaxim: Bandwidth limit as a fraction of the current maximum, not a hard number.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchUseEstimatedBan: 0 — actual data sent last frame, 1 — rough estimate.
cfgvar.networkRangeClose: Network bubble (m): close objects with items inside (backpacks). Default 20.
cfgvar.networkRangeNear: Network bubble (m): near inventory items. Default 150.
cfgvar.password: Password to join the server (empty — no password).
cfgvar.pingCritical: Ping (ms) at which the red ping warning is shown.
cfgvar.pingWarning: Ping (ms) at which the yellow ping warning is shown.
cfgvar.respawnTime: Delay (seconds) before a new character can be created after death.
cfgvar.serverFpsWarning: Server FPS below which the warning is shown (minimum 11).
cfgvar.simulatedPlayersBatch: Limit of players simulated per server frame.
cfgvar.timeStampFormat: Timestamp format in the RPT: Full or Short.
cfgvar.verifySignatures: PBO signature verification: 2 — enabled (.bikey files required in keys), 0 — disabled (for development).

filepatch.clear_confirm:
Remove all filepatching links from every root?

The script folders on drive P: are left untouched — only the links to them are removed.

filepatch.help:
The symlink is what makes filepatching work. Filepatching lets you pick up script changes without packing the PBO — restarting the client and server is enough.

To set it up, point to your mod's scripts folder on drive P:. The links will then be created automatically everywhere they are needed — in both client and server, stable and Experimental.
filepatch.pick: Mod scripts folder on drive P:
filepatch.sync_tip: Creates any missing links in all roots and removes those whose folder on drive P: is gone.
flags.hint: Flags are mod labels with a custom name and color. The color paints the mod's name in the lists. Assigned via right-click on a mod on the «Mods» tab → «Flags».
flags.title: Mod flags
launch.be_launcher: Starting the client through the BattlEye launcher
launch.be_no_client: The BattlEye launcher did not bring up the client within {sec} s — check that the BattlEye service is installed (BattlEye/Install_BattlEye.bat, admin rights required).

launch.pack_skipped: Packing skipped: the running game holds the PBOs. Launching with what is already built.
launch.pack_wait_failed: The packing did not finish — launch cancelled.
launch.pack_wait_other: A mod is being packed — waiting for it before starting
launch.server_died: Server exited during startup (code {code}). Check the RPT log.
launch.server_slow: Server {what} within {sec} s — starting the client anyway.
launch.window_hidden: Server window hidden ({n} window(s), after {t:.1f} s)
launch.window_never_shown: The server window never appeared — the launch-time request was enough

log.delete_tip: Deletes all log files in the folder. The window is not cleared.

log.no_files: No files of this kind in the folder.
log.no_session: The client or server has not been started yet — nothing to show.
log.on_top_tip: The window will not slip behind the game or the editor.
log.only_matches_tip: Keep only matching lines. The search then runs over the files on disk, not over what is shown.
main.about:
Version {v}

A quick DayZ test server and mod packing — without a single batch file.

GPLv3 licensed — free forever.
https://github.com/KRdayzmodding/KR_QTS

by [Kramtsov Arms]

param.BEpath: Custom path to the BattlEye files.
param.adminLog: Writes a log of admin actions and hits (ADM file).
param.battleye: Enable/disable BattlEye. For Diag and local development set 0 (disabled).
param.cpuCount: Number of CPU cores the server may use.
param.doLogs: Enables server logs (RPT, script.log) in the profile folder.
param.filePatching: Allows loading unpacked files (sources) over PBOs. Required for debugging without packing. Diag builds usually require 1.
param.freezeCheck: Watches for server freezes and writes a dump on freeze.
param.limitFPS: Server loop FPS limit, max 200 (reduces CPU load).
param.name: Client character name.
param.netLog: Enables network traffic logging. Rarely needed, slows the server down.
param.newErrorsAreWarnings: New script errors are treated as warnings — the game does not crash on them (Diag only).
param.noPause: Do not pause the game when the window is minimized/unfocused.
param.password: Server password, if set in serverDZ.cfg (password).
param.scrDef: Script preprocessor definitions, e.g. BITWISEDEBUG (Diag only).
param.storage: Custom root folder for the storage (persistence files).
param.window: Start the client in windowed mode.
paths.cleanup_body:
The old files are still in place. Delete them?

paths.failed_body:
The setting was left as it was, the files were not touched.

{e}

pbo.appid_tip: Leave empty unless this is paid DLC content.
pbo.b_tip: Checks mission.sqm and config.cpp for errors via a trial binarisation.
pbo.c_tip: “All bets are off” — rebuilds absolutely everything, including what hasn't changed.
pbo.clean_meta_tip: *.meta is Workbench clutter that throws off comparing source/pbo dates.
pbo.d_tip: png files successfully converted to paa are deleted from the temp folder.
pbo.extra_hint: Recognised as-is from previous settings — appended unchanged at the end.
pbo.g_tip: Subscribers of the corresponding Mikero service only.
pbo.h_tip: DayZ sometimes uses png directly — disables the attempt to convert it to paa.
pbo.hint: pboProject command-line flags. “Not set” — use whatever is left configured in pboProject itself (unpredictable between runs); set it explicitly if the exact behaviour matters.
pbo.k_file_tip: Needed if PBO signing is enabled above.

pbo.n_tip: A lot of extra output — useful when tracking down an error, but noticeably slows down packing.
pbo.o_tip: Protects the code from being read in a hex editor, but an obfuscated pbo can no longer be extracted.
pbo.p_tip: Required for automated builds — without it pboProject may open its GUI and wait for user input, hanging the build.
pbo.q: Delete wav/wss after converting to ogg
pbo.title: PboProject settings

pbo.x_excl_tip: Comma-separated files/masks that won't go into the pbo at all.
pbo.z_excl_tip: Comma-separated files/masks that shouldn't be compressed (e.g. *.paa,*.ogg).
pbo.z_tip: The compression-exclusion list is a separate field below.

Delete storage_* in mission "{m}"?

{c}  and  {p}

preset.open_prof_tip: Opens the server profile folder in Explorer.
preset.restart_msg_tip: %t is replaced with the time left, unit included: “5 min”, “30 sec”. Do not write the unit yourself.

preset.times_none: No times set — there will be no restarts.
preset.warn_min_tip: The cadence is fixed after that: once a minute, every 10 seconds in the last minute, every 5 in the last half-minute.
settings.admin_pass_tip: Up to 32 characters, Latin letters/digits/symbols — no Cyrillic or spaces. Empty means admin login without a password (vppDisablePassword = 1 in serverDZ.cfg).
settings.admins_tip: Admin SteamID64s — one per line. Used by admin mods.
settings.downloads_tip: Shared storage for downloaded map mods; they are attached to every root via junction links.
settings.engine_no_pbo: Packing unavailable: pboProject not found at the given path.
settings.engine_no_tools: Packing unavailable: DayZ Tools not found.
settings.engine_tip: Normal reuses the temp contents and builds in seconds; full clears temp and rebuilds everything.
settings.mikero_hint: pboProject is part of Mikero Tools and requires DayZ Tools to be installed — binarization won't work without them.
settings.path_missing: There is no folder at this path.
settings.path_not_installed: The program is not at this path — only the folder is left.
settings.paths_locked: Unavailable while the server or client is running.
settings.paths_tip: Where the app puts configs, profiles, missions and mod links inside the game root.
settings.pbo_settings_missing: pboProject was not found at the configured Mikero Tools path — fix the path to open these settings.
settings.pbo_settings_tip: pboProject command-line flags: signing, compression, file processing, etc. — with an explanation for each.

sid.add_tip: Add a SteamID or a profile link

Setup is complete. Everything can be changed later in "Settings".

Next: create or pick a preset, attach mods on the "Mods" tab
and press "Launch".
wizard.no_workshop: Workshop not found (can be set later in Settings)
wizard.paths_help: It is fine if something was not found or is not installed — you can leave the field empty and fill it in later in Settings once everything is ready. A red outline means the path is set but there is no folder at it, or the program itself is not in it (for example, the game was removed but the folder stayed, or the registry still holds a trace of an old install). DayZ, the Experimental build and the dedicated server are installed and updated through Steam (game library, and the Tools tab for DayZ Tools); Mikero Tools (DePboTools) is a separate free utility from the developer's site, found by name.
wizard.paths_sub: Paths were detected from the Steam registry. Review and adjust if needed.
wizard.prefix_hint: Will be inserted into the hostname of created servers — no need to type it in every time. Can be changed later in Settings.
wizard.redetect_tip: Re-reads Steam libraries and fills in empty fields.
wizard.steam_sub: The field is optional and easy to fill in later in Settings — but it's simplest not to forget it now.
wizard.title: KR Quick Test Server — first-time setup
paths.err_absolute: The path must be relative — no drive letter.
paths.err_updir: Going above the root («..») is not supported: the launch path must stay relative.
cli.arg.cExtra: Append arbitrary arguments to the client as they are.
cli.arg.client: Launch the client. Minus means do not, even if the preset says so.
cli.arg.detach: Return immediately without waiting for readiness.
cli.arg.forget: Forget the record about a mod. Never touches files.
cli.arg.help: Help on a topic: commands, basic, mods, pack, params, output, exit.
cli.arg.json: Machine-readable report instead of a human one.
cli.arg.mod: Mods for client and server. Plus adds to the preset, minus replaces the whole list.
cli.arg.pack: Pack changed sources of the launch mods. Minus means do not pack at all.
cli.arg.preset: Preset used as the base of the launch.
cli.arg.rebuild: Rebuild everything, not only what changed.
cli.arg.sExtra: Append arbitrary arguments to the server as they are.
cli.arg.server: Launch the server. Minus means do not, even if the preset says so.
cli.arg.src: Source folder of the last mod. Plus binds, minus unbinds. Explicit form: +src:@Mod=path.
cli.arg.timeout: Overall wait limit. Packing is counted separately.
cli.arg.wait: Wait for readiness, no longer than the given number of seconds. On by default in the console.
cli.help.ex_addmod: Add a mod on top of the preset
cli.help.ex_filepatching: Start server and client with file patching, without repacking
cli.help.ex_newmod: Build a new mod from sources and connect it
cli.help.ex_pack_server: Pack what changed and start the server
cli.help.exit_note: Script errors never affect the exit code — they go to the report as a separate list, and what to do with them is up to the caller.
cli.help.json_note: «-help -json» gives a program the same thing: commands and arguments with types.
cli.help.params_note: An empty value removes a parameter set in the preset: «-cScrDef=» means «do not pass it at all».
cli.help.rule_base: The preset is the base, arguments are an overlay for one launch: they are never written into the preset.
cli.help.rule_minus: «-» means exactly this: set a value, replace a list, turn a flag off.
cli.help.rule_plus: «+» means on top of what is there: add to a list, turn a flag on.
cli.help.title: KR QTS — external control
cli.arg.start: Start QTS if it is not running: no window is shown, it goes to the tray.
cli.no_engine_hint: Start the program, or add +start to bring it up silently, without a window.
cli.no_answer: KR QTS is running but does not answer: {e}
cli.unknown_cmd_hint: Known ones: launch, restart, stop, status, show, quit.
cli.busy_hint: Wait for it to finish, or shut down: qtsctl stop
cli.no_presets: The program has no presets at all.
cli.preflight: The pre-launch check did not pass:
settings.cli_note: Third-party tools and editor tasks can start the server and client, pack mods and get a report without opening this window. The channel is personal: another user of this machine cannot reach it.
settings.cli_help_note: Full help with all arguments is «qtsctl -help», by topic: -help mods, -help pack, -help params, -help exit.
cli.disabled_hint: Turn it on in the settings, section «External control».
cli.arg.hard: Shut down forcefully, without waiting for a clean exit. Minus means the opposite, gracefully only. Without a sign — as configured in the program.
cli.help.ex_restart: Restart the server, rebuilding what changed
cli.cmd.launch: Start the server and client from a preset. The verb may be omitted — a command without a verb means launch.
cli.cmd.restart: Shut down and start again. Takes the same arguments as launch. If nothing was running, it simply starts.
cli.cmd.stop: Shut down. Without a qualifier — everything that runs; +server or +client — only those.
cli.cmd.status: What is running now. Sides, state, script errors, paths to the logs.
cli.cmd.quit: Quit the program. A running server keeps working — it is a separate process.
cfg.in_file: Write this key to the file
cfg.hint2: An unchecked box means the key is absent from the file and the server uses its own default. Comments and line order are preserved; the file is written as UTF-8 without BOM.
cfg.unknown_hint: The key is not in the reference — the program leaves it alone.
main.hero_prep: Packing mods, then starting the server
main.hero_no_client: The client is not running — the server is untouched
main.mods_row_desc: What is attached to the server and client at launch.
main.pack_row_desc: A mod whose sources are newer than its PBO is packed before the start — the changes reach the game.
main.pack_flags_desc: The same as in the settings, but close at hand.
main.hide_server_window_desc: Everything the server window used to print goes to the journal below.
main.preset_params_desc: Paths, mode, port, launch parameters and serverDZ.cfg.
main.journal_empty: The launch journal appears here: packing mods, starting the server, script memory usage and errors.
main.mods_none: No mods attached — the server will come up vanilla.
